name: bandwidth-atlas
description: PCIe Speed Explorer: interactive comparison of PCIe generations and lane widths against USB, HDMI, Ethernet, Wi-Fi and JEDEC DDR RAM. Static, cited, no tracking.
author: Paolo Velati

scripts.build: node scripts/generate-data.mjs && vite build --base=${BASE_PATH:-/} && node scripts/prerender.mjs
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test

overrides.comment: force patched MLSD parser (GHSA-5pm8-86m8-9m6r) in the puppeteer -> proxy-agent -> get-uri chain; dev-only, never exercised at runtime
